description: Source file implementing SensorDirectConnection class for Android sensor service, managing direct sensor channels, configuration, and access control.

classes.name: SensorService::SensorDirectConnection
classes.description: Manages a direct connection to a sensor, including configuration, access control, and resource management.

methods.name: configureChannel
methods.description: Configures the sensor direct channel with specified handle and rate level, managing activation and permissions.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Stops all active sensor direct channels, optionally backing up the current state.

methods.name: isEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if the given memory handle is equivalent to the current one.

methods.name: getHalChannelHandle
methods.description: Returns the HAL channel handle associated with this connection.
